title: Lifted tensor-section sheaves have zero positive finite affine Cech cohomology
statement: Let X be a scheme, F a quasi-coherent X-module and G the universe lift of its associated tensor-section sheaf [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module]. For U,I,V,f belonging to the finite affine cover collection of [new-etale-finite-affine-cech-basis], the Mathlib Cech complex of G restricted along Over.forget U has zero homology in every positive natural degree p. No affineness of X is assumed.

source.place: Etale Cohomology Theorem Tag 03P2 affine case; Lemma Tag 03OZ; original parent proof step 2

proof.text: Use new-etale-affine-tensor-cech-amitsur-comparison to obtain B over the actual ring A = Gamma(U, O_U), faithful flatness, and a complex isomorphism with the lifted underlying-group Amitsur complex for M = Gamma(U, U.hom*F).

Write the positive degree p as q+1. Apply Module.FaithfullyFlat.exact_amitsurComplex at q. Map the resulting exact short complex through forgetful ModuleCat to AddCommGrpCat and then ULift. Both functors preserve homology, so the mapped complex is exact at q+1.
Transport exactness along the inverse comparison isomorphism and apply HomologicalComplex.ExactAt.isZero_homology. This gives precisely the stated zero homology, including degree one.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03P2 and 03OZ. Geometric complex comparison split off; faithfully flat exactness, preservation under forgetting scalars and ULift, and transport of exactness implemented in Lean.

theorem isZero_etaleTensorSectionsSheaf_ulift_cech
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U : X.Etale) (I : Type (u + 1)) (V : I → X.Etale) (f : ∀ i : I, V i ⟶ U)
    (hf : finiteAffineEtaleCechCover X U I V f) (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    IsZero (((cechComplexFunctor fun i : I ↦ Over.mk (f i)).obj
      ((Over.forget U).op ⋙
        ((sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).obj
          (Modules.etaleTensorSectionsSheaf F)).obj)).homology p)
